```python
import requests

domain = "yahoo.com"

    "x-apikey": api_key,
}

response = requests.get(f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}", headers=headers)
print("Domain info:", response.json())

# Get DNS records
dns_response = requests.get(f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{domain}/dns_records", headers=headers)
print("DNS records:", dns_response.json())
```
